summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) providing a periodic update on its ongoing share buyback program. The filing details the second tranche of a multi-year €3.5 billion buyback program expected to be executed by 2030, as announced on April 10, 2026. During the reported period (June 3-10, 2026), Ferrari purchased 30,899 common shares on Euronext Milan for €9.3 million, and since the second tranche began, has bought 391,709 shares (EXM) and 62,087 shares (NYSE) for €114.2 million and $20.5 million, respectively. The company held 17,873,467 treasury shares (9.22% of total issued common shares) as of June 10, 2026, with a planned cancellation of treasury shares approved but not yet effectuated. This is a routine disclosure of an open-market buyback program, not a tender offer. Watch for completion pace and potential share cancellation impact on float.
